criteria.text: Provide a machine-derivable public-surface extractor (scripts/extract_product_surface.py) that parses open_fleet CLI commands, MCP tools, MCP resources, GitHub Action outputs, and doc-embedded file:symbol anchors directly from live code and docs/cli-and-mcp.md (no hand-copied lists), verifies 100% coverage (reference table scoped, fail-closed on missing files/empty surfaces) plus one-hop Markdown link reachability from README.md and docs/README.md.

Provide executable negative controls in tests/test_product_surface_and_wheel.py proving that renaming a doc-anchored production symbol, adding a bogus doc anchor, dropping documented entities, breaking Markdown links, or deleting required files turns the claim check RED while clean head passes, and wire scripts/extract_product_surface.py --check into tests/test_entrypoint_guard.py, scripts/check.py, .github/workflows/validate.yml, and .github/workflows/product-package.yml.

intent.goal: Cover the open_fleet product surface in docs/cli-and-mcp.md with zero critical gaps, 18 AST-verified doc-embedded file:symbol anchors, resolved one-hop Markdown reachability, and CI/local enforcement.
intent.ruled_out: hand-copied symbol allowlists decoupled from docs (caught and eliminated after Round 1 NO-GO); permissive substring link matching and cached sys.modules loads (eliminated after Round 2 NO-GO)
intent.why: documentation that is not extracted from live code and bound to AST-verified anchors silently drifts; a rename-to-RED negative control proves the anchor oracle is live

toolchain: Python 3.12 on Linux; git; unittest; independent build-blind research subagents (R1 NO-GO -> R2 NO-GO -> R3 GO)
claim: DOC-1 extracted 100% of open_fleet public surface and 18 doc-embedded AST anchors; rename-to-RED and broken-link negative controls KILLED; wired into check.py and validate.yml; blind review GO round 3.
